content: {"summary":"To verify whether PostgreSQL is still serving the old certificate, fetch the server‑presented cert with openssl and compare its serial/enddate to the certificate file on disk. PostgreSQL only picks up a new cert after a configuration reload (or restart). The replica (auth-db‑02) has its own cert and timer and must be checked and reloaded in the same way. A similar incident occurred in April 2025 when the timer wrote a new cert but PostgreSQL was not reloaded, so the old cert continued to be served.","likely_cause":"PostgreSQL has not been reloaded after the certificate files were renewed, so it continues to present the previous certificate.","confidence":"high","claims":[{"text":"Compare the server-presented certificate with the on-disk file using openssl.","evidence_ids":["RB-024#2"],"quote":"Compare what the server sends with what is on disk:"},{"text":"PostgreSQL loads a new certificate only after a reload or restart.","evidence_ids":["RB-024#1"],"quote":"Postgres reads `ssl_cert_file` and `ssl_key_file` when it starts and when its configuration is reloaded."},{"text":"The replica also requires its own certificate and timer and must be reloaded similarly.","evidence_ids":["RB-024#3"],"quote":"Yes. auth-db-02 has its own certificate and its own timer."},{"text":"In April 2025 the timer wrote a new cert but PostgreSQL was not reloaded, so it kept serving the expired cert.","evidence_ids":["RB-024#4"],"quote":"The timer had written a valid replacement on 2025-03-09, but nothing told Postgres to load it."}],"next_checks":["Run `openssl s_client -starttls postgres -connect auth-db-01.prod.internal:5432` and compare its serial/enddate to `/etc/postgresql/16/main/server.crt`.","If they differ, execute `SELECT pg_reload_conf();` on the primary to load the new cert.","Repeat the openssl comparison on auth-db-02 and, if needed, reload its config similarly.","Check `systemctl list-timers pg-cert-renew.timer` and recent `journalctl -u pg-cert-renew.service` logs on both primary and replica to confirm the timer ran successfully."]}
